snippet_primary: "I signed up for a classes that was posted in an Art group on Facebook I have been following for years. I paid and I got an email that I could access the classes. I had no access. I sent 3 tickets with photos of payment and showing no access. Nothing was solved and they erased my account. I contacted the instructor on Facebook. She send me messages through Pateron but the message button does not work and therefore I can't reply back. Basically, left out in the cold. I asked for a refund on my last ticket and no reply back. I believe they scam people out of money and impossible to contact."
